    <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <!-- SEO METADATA -->
    <title>BizTemplates Pro | Professional Business Document Library</title>
    <meta name="description" content="All-in-one professional business document library: 116 invoices, receipts, proposals, P&L statements, client databases, contracts, and tracking tools." />
    <meta name="keywords" content="business templates, invoice template, profit and loss template, proposal template, client database, business tracker" />
    <link rel="canonical" href="https://maraujo0209-hub.github.io/invoice-templates/" />
    <!-- Open Graph / Social Media -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
    <meta property="og:title" content="BizTemplates Pro - Professional Business Document Library" />
    <meta property="og:description" content="Everything you need to run your business professionally. Invoices, contracts, P&L trackers, proposals, and operational tools." />
    <style>
    :root {
    --bg-main: #f8fafc;
    --bg-card: #ffffff;
    --bg-hero: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%);
    --text-main: #0f172a;
    --text-muted: #64748b;
    --border-color: #e2e8f0;
    --primary: #10b981;
    --primary-dark: #059669;
    --accent: #3b82f6;
    }
    body.dark-mode {
    --bg-main: #0f172a;
    --bg-card: #1e293b;
    --text-main: #f8fafc;
    --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    --border-color: #334155;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; }
    body {
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    margin: 0; padding: 0;
    background-color: var(--bg-main);
    color: var(--text-main);
    line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.25rem; }
    .text-center { text-align: center; }
    .section-title { font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; text-align: center; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
    .section-subtitle { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem auto; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .top-nav {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); background: var(--bg-card);
    }
    .brand-logo { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--text-main); text-decoration: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .brand-logo span { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .nav-actions { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; }
    .theme-toggle {
    background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-main);
    padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
    }
    .hero-section {
    background: var(--bg-hero); color: #ffffff;
    padding: 5rem 1rem 4rem 1rem; text-align: center;
    }
    .hero-section h1 { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 1.25rem 0; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.15; }
    .hero-subtitle { font-size: 1.25rem; color: #94a3b8; max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 2.25rem auto; line-height: 1.6; }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .btn-hero-primary {
    background: var(--primary); color: #ffffff; padding: 0.95rem 1.85rem;
    border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 1.05rem;
    }
    .btn-hero-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }
    .btn-hero-secondary {
    background: #334155; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.95rem 1.85rem;
    border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 1.05rem;
    }
    .trust-badges { background: var(--bg-card); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 1.5rem 0; }
    .trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; text-align: center; }
    .trust-item h4 { margin: 0.25rem 0 0 0; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-main); }
    .trust-item p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .trust-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; }
    .section-block { padding: 4.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .pricing-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 2rem;
    align-items: stretch; margin-top: 1.5rem;
    }
    .price-card {
    background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 2.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative;
    }
    .price-card.ultimate-card {
    border: 2px solid var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px -5px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.03) 100%);
    }
    .badge-ultimate {
    position: absolute; top: -14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--primary); color: #fff; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 50px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .price-card h3 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0; }
    .price-target { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; }
    .price-amount { font-size: 2.75rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem; }
    .price-amount span { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .included-list-title { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .price-features { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 2rem 0; flex: 1; }
    .price-features li { padding: 0.45rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-color); font-size: 0.9rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-main); }
    .price-features li strong { font-weight: 700; }
    .btn-price {
    width: 100%; text-align: center; padding: 0.9rem; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; display: block; border: none; font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .btn-price-primary { background: var(--primary); color: #ffffff; }
    .btn-price-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }
    .btn-price-secondary { background: var(--text-main); color: var(--bg-card); }
    .category-title {
    font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; margin: 2.5rem 0 1.25rem 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-color); padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .card-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }
    .template-card {
    background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .template-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
    .card-preview-thumb {
    background: #f1f5f9; height: 140px; padding: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    }
    body.dark-mode .card-preview-thumb { background: #0b1329; }
    .thumb-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .card-tier-badge {
    position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .tier-starter { background: #e2e8f0; color: #334155; }
    .tier-pro { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
    .tier-ultimate { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
    .card-body { padding: 1.25rem; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .card-title { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0; color: var(--text-main); }
    .card-desc { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1rem; line-height: 1.4; flex: 1; }
    .card-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: auto; }
    .btn-card {
    flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 0.65rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .btn-preview-card { background: var(--bg-main); color: var(--text-main); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .btn-preview-card:hover { border-color: var(--text-main); }
    .btn-use-card { background: var(--text-main); color: var(--bg-card); border: none; }
    .btn-use-card:hover { opacity: 0.9; }
    .vs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
    .vs-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.75rem; }
    .vs-card.paid { border: 2px solid var(--primary); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-card) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.02) 100%); }
    .vs-card h3 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .vs-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
    .vs-list li { padding: 0.6rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); font-size: 0.925rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .modal {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85); z-index: 20000;
    display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem;
    }
    .modal-content {
    background: var(--bg-card); width: 100%; max-width: 1050px; height: 92vh;
    border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    }
    .modal-header {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff;
    }
    .modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .btn-modal-action {
    background: #1e293b; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #475569;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
    }
    .btn-modal-unlock {
    background: var(--primary); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--primary);
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .btn-modal-unlock:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); border-color: var(--primary-dark); }
    .modal-body-wrap { flex: 1; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .modal-body { border: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #fff; display: block; }
    .modal-preview-gate {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 5;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(15,23,42,0) 65%, rgba(15,23,42,0.92) 100%);
    display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 2rem;
    pointer-events: none;
    }
    .modal-preview-gate .btn-modal-unlock { pointer-events: auto; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; }
    .faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; }
    .faq-item { background: var(--bg-card); padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
    .faq-item h4 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .faq-item p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; }
    .site-footer { background: #0f172a; color: #94a3b8; padding: 4rem 0 2rem 0; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .footer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
    .footer-grid h4 { color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 1rem; margin-top: 0; }
    .footer-grid a { color: #94a3b8; text-decoration: none; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .footer-grid a:hover { color: #ffffff; }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .hero-section h1 { font-size: 2.25rem; }
    .hero-actions { flex-direction: column; }
    }
    </style>

    <!-- HEADER NAV -->
    <header style="background: var(--bg-card);">
    <div class="container">
    <nav class="top-nav">
    <a href="#" class="brand-logo">BizTemplates <span>Pro Toolkit</span></a>
    <div class="nav-actions">
    <button class="theme-toggle" onclick="toggleDarkMode()">🌙 Dark Mode</button>
    </div>
    </nav>
    </div>
    </header>
    <!-- HERO SECTION -->
    <section class="hero-section">
    <div class="container">
    <h1>116 Professional Business Documents & Trackers</h1>
    <p class="hero-subtitle">Everything you need to run your business professionally—from invoices, quotes, and legal agreements to financial spreadsheets, HR logs, and operational dashboards.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
    <a href="#pricing" class="btn-hero-primary">View Pricing & Plans</a>
    <a href="#collection" class="btn-hero-secondary">Explore All 116 Templates</a>
    </div>
    </div>
    </section>
    <!-- TRUST BADGES -->
    <div class="trust-badges">
    <div class="container">
    <div class="trust-grid">
    <div class="trust-item"><div class="trust-icon">💳</div><h4>One-Time Purchase</h4><p>No monthly subscriptions</p></div>

    <script>
    function toggleDarkMode() {
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark-mode');
    }
    function openPreview(url, title) {
    document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = 'Preview: ' + title;
    document.getElementById('modalIframe').src = url;
    document.getElementById('previewModal').style.display = 'flex';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closePreview() {
    document.getElementById('previewModal').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('modalIframe').src = 'about:blank';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'auto';
    }
    function closeModalOnBackdrop(e) {
    if (e.target.id === 'previewModal') {
    closePreview();
    }
    }
    </script>
